collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SL Class Convertible 2002 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz SL-Class Convertible (2002 to 2011) requires windscreen wiper blades to ensure clear visibility in all weather conditions. The driver's side blade should be 26" in length, while the passenger's side blade should be 26". These windscreen wiper blades are specifically designed to fit the Mercedes-Benz SL-Class Convertible 2002 to 2011 model, which features a Side Pin type arm attachment for easy installation. Trust our high-quality windscreen wiper blades to maintain excellent visibility and keep you safe on the road.
